tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You have recently moved into a new apartment and are experiencing issues with the heating system. You need to contact the property manager, Ms. Green, to report the problem and request a repair.
Write an email to Ms. Green. In your email, do the following:
​​​​​​​• Request a repair and ask for a timeline for when it will be fixed.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe the issues you are experiencing with the heating system.
Explain how these issues are affecting your daily life.
tasks.to: Ms. Green Subject: Heating system repair request
tasks.subject: Heating system repair request
tasks.title: Write an Email
